slides.heading: Three bottlenecks every AI deployment hits

cards.title: Routing chaos
cards.body: Teams juggle 12 providers with brittle failover and unpredictable latency.

cards.title: Edge distance
cards.body: Users wait on distant regions — p95 climbs past 800ms outside the US.

cards.title: Cost blindness
cards.body: Spend spikes without quality signal. Finance finds out after the invoice.

cards.title: Smart routing
cards.body: Real-time selection across 12 providers — fastest, cheapest path per request.

cards.title: Global edge
cards.body: 50+ nodes. Sub-200ms for 95% of the world's population.

cards.title: Live cost & quality
cards.body: Dashboards, latency histograms, quality scoring — before the bill.
